title: One Piece Episode 1169 Preview Trailer Teases Scopper Gaban
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1169, teasing Scopper Gaban appearing on Elbaph. The anime is returning after a 1-week break, which was made for the ONE PIECE HEROINES episode. The anime previously returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Creditless Opening & Ending Videos Released
content: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You anime revealed the creditless version of its opening and ending videos following the premiere on July 9, 2026. Ahead of the TV premiere, ABEMA streamed a special early-release version of the series.

title: 3 New Summer Anime Airing on Crunchyroll Right Now That Are Absolutely Worth Watching
content: Summer 2026 is coming in hot, and the anime industry is following suit with a wave of exciting new series. As the world’s leading anime streaming platform, Crunchyroll is naturally home to the majority of the new anime currently airing.

title: Inuyasha Creator’s New Anime Confirms Unexpected Delay
content: 2026 is one of the most exciting years for anime fans, as it introduces several new series, including an underrated fantasy by the creator of Inuyasha . Rumiko Takahashi is one of the most renowned manga creators of all time, best known for her acclaimed fantasy Inuyasha .

title: Star Wars Gets Closer Than Ever to Major Emmy Win for Its Coolest Anime
content: Star Wars has been working its way through a cool anime anthology now streaming with Disney+, and it’s one step closer to nabbing the franchise’s first notable Emmy in the Outstanding Animated Program category for quite a while.

title: One of HIDIVE’s Best Isekai Is Coming Back for Season 2

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, June 29-July 5
content: A marathon re-airing of the sixth season of the Solitary Gourmet live-action series aired on TV Tokyo on Wednesday, July 1 at 5:45 p.m. and it earned a 3.8% rating. Detective Conan took a break this week, and did not air an episode on July 4.

title: 7 Years Later, Surprise Crunchyroll Anime to Return With Live-Action Movie – Watch Trailer
content: Seven years after this franchise made its original anime streaming debut with Crunchyroll , a major series has confirmed it’s coming back for a new live-action feature film adaptation. It’s been a big few years for live-action anime and manga adaptations, and there are even more in production than ever seen before .
